title: the UI pass could render the help hint at a fixed list of narrow widths (80, 70, 60, 50, 40) and flag a hint that keeps quit while it drops scroll

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-133013-979c, project ork, item S535:

the UI pass could render the help hint at a fixed list of narrow widths (80, 70, 60, 50, 40) and flag a hint that keeps quit while it drops scroll

Evidence: the 60x16 test passed, but 50x14 shows "? or esc close help; q quit" over "+42 more lines"
